mentor.name: Rahul Dukare
mentor.bio:
I've delivered Seven upstream implementations across Sourcing, Contract Management, Supplier Lifecycle & Performance (SLP), Buying & Invoicing, Guided Buying and Supply Chain Collaboration, including integration with SAP S/4HANA through Cloud Integration Gateway.

My work covers the full SAP Ariba implementation methodology: scoping, blueprint, requirements gathering, process and application design, configuration, integration testing, UAT, go-live and hypercare. I also work on SAP MM Procure-to-Pay: purchase requisitions, purchase orders, goods receipt and invoice verification.

faqs.q: Do I need prior SAP experience?
faqs.a: No. Basic procurement knowledge helps, but Week 1 covers the fundamentals. Learners with SAP MM experience will progress faster.

faqs.q: What if I miss a live class?
faqs.a: Every session is recorded and shared within 24 hours, so you can catch up anytime and bring your doubts to the next class.
Yes. You receive an Ariba Academy certificate of completion after finishing the course and the capstone project. Official SAP certification exams are booked separately with SAP.
We provide resume review, mock interviews and job-search guidance. We do not guarantee placement.
If the course isn't right for you, request a refund within 7 days of your batch start date for a full refund.
